$comment: Pack Rat bridge protocol v1. Draft-07 style, restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mjs supports (no $ref/oneOf), so this file holds three independent schemas — command, result and status — each validated separately (app/contracts.test.mjs does one validate() call per shape). command = one line of <dataDir>/bridge/<adapter-id>/queue.jsonl (app/config.mts's paths.bridgeQueueFor(adapter) — per adapter, not a fixed 'tazuo'), written by POST /api/bridge (app/vault-server.mts, resolving <adapter-id> from settings.client.adapter) and read by that adapter's own packrat-bridge.py (e.g. adapters/tazuo/packrat-bridge.py). result = one entry of status.results, keyed by the command's id. status = <dataDir>/bridge/<adapter-id>/status.json (paths.bridgeStatusFor(adapter)), written by that adapter's packrat-bridge.py (alive is always rfc3339_now(); a clean stop adds stopped:true, never the old numeric 0) and read by GET /api/bridge/status.

id.$comment: The app writes a 36-character randomUUID(). 64 matches MAX_ID in every packrat-bridge.py, which refuses a longer id: results are keyed by id, so an unbounded one would grow status.json.

name.$comment: Only ever printed on screen. 120 matches MAX_NAME in every packrat-bridge.py, which truncates to it. POST /api/bridge validates every queue line against this schema (app/schema/validate.mts implements maxLength), so an over-long name is refused at the route with a 400 as well as truncated by the adapters.

chain.$comment: The container chain the bridge opens, outermost first. Capped at 8 — app/ui/bridge.mts's chainOf() walks at most 8 parents, and the scanner's own MAX_NEST is 4, so nothing legitimate is longer. Enforced twice: POST /api/bridge validates every queue line against this schema (app/schema/validate.mts implements maxItems) and refuses a longer chain with a 400, and each adapter's packrat-bridge.py re-checks it (MAX_CHAIN).

pos.$comment: The root container's world tile, or null when the app has none on file. x/y bounds are the widest UO facet (Britannia, 7168x4096); every other facet is smaller, so this is a sanity bound rather than a per-facet one. Each adapter's packrat-bridge.py re-validates this exact shape itself and additionally refuses a destination further than MAX_WALK_TILES (24 tiles, the client's own view range) from where the character is standing — a queue line must never be able to walk a character across the map.

facet.$comment: 0 Felucca, 1 Trammel, 2 Ilshenar, 3 Malas, 4 Tokuno, 5 Ter Mur. Optional, and nothing writes it today; the bridges validate it but do not act on it until a writer exists — the fold never carries a container's pos, so POST /api/bridge sends pos:null in practice, and a scan's own root pos is {x, y, z}. A writer that starts carrying the facet has a typed place for it.

queuedAt.$comment: RFC 3339, same pattern as result.t — POST /api/bridge writes new Date().toISOString(). Each bridge parses it and refuses a command older than 60 s (a replayed backlog) or more than 5 s in the future.
